draft.text: You came in because you got a tick bite around your knee a week ago.
It has been burning and annoying you.
You have a bull's-eye rash around the bite area, with some redness and swelling.
You don't have pain or trouble walking.
This could be a sign of Lyme disease or another tick-borne illness.
You feel generally unwell but don't have fever, chills, or headaches.
The doctor will check you again and may do tests to find out more.
You should watch the rash and tell them if it changes or gets worse.

You don't have pain or other symptoms like fever or chills, but you feel a little unwell.
